Frequently Asked Questions

What is included in a Dubai Desert Safari?
A standard evening Dubai desert safari with Phoenix Travel & Tours includes door-to-door 4x4 hotel pickup, 35–45 minutes of dune bashing across Lahbab Red Dunes, sandboarding, camel rides, live Tanoura, fire show and belly dance performances, and a 5-star international BBQ dinner buffet with vegetarian and non-vegetarian menus.
How much does a Dubai desert safari cost?
Dubai desert safari prices start from AED 120 per person for sharing 4x4 transfers with full desert camp access, AED 180 for VIP Majlis service, and AED 900 for a private luxury Toyota Land Cruiser accommodating up to 6 guests.
What time does evening desert safari start and how long is it?
Evening desert safari pickup takes place between 2:30 PM and 3:30 PM depending on your hotel location in Dubai. The complete experience lasts 6 hours, returning between 9:00 PM and 9:30 PM.
